company.name: Mandiant
company.shortDescription: Mandiant is an information security company that provides incident response and computer forensic solutions and services.
company.description:
Mandiant is the information security industry's leading provider of incident response and computer forensics solutions and services. Headquartered in Alexandria, Virginia, with offices in New York, Los Angeles, and San Francisco, Mandiant provides products, professional services, and education to Fortune 500 companies, financial institutions, government agencies, domestic and foreign police departments, and U.S. law firms.

Mandiant comprises the industry's largest incident response and forensics forces. The authors of nine books, Mandiant security consultants and engineers hold top government security clearances and certifications and advanced degrees from some of the most prestigious computer science universities.

aiResearchSummary.text: Mandiant is engaged in developing advanced machine learning techniques for cybersecurity. One area of focus is churn-aware training of classifiers, which aims to minimize prediction discrepancies between different model generations, enhancing threat detection capabilities. Another area involves training machine learning models to infer file properties and detect threats, utilizing labeled datasets to improve cybersecurity measures. These efforts highlight Mandiant's commitment to advancing incident response and forensic solutions through innovative machine learning applications.
